launch_policy.publication_cadence: After launch, publish up to two completed articles or blogs per day, alternating articles and blogs. Each must pass the research, citation, content, SEO, and AI-language checks; the production deploy fails if it does not.
launch_policy.scheduling: Set draft: false and a future published date to schedule a post. Production hides it until that date in publish_timezone; the daily production deploy publishes it. check-content allows at most one article and one blog per date from cadence_start_date.
launch_policy.editorial_backlog: data/launch-content-plan.json keeps the original 10 articles and 10 blogs as the editorial plan. It is not a launch requirement and drafts never block a release.
